question.text: Under the income-only criterion, what annual income is needed for an individual to qualify as an accredited investor?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the income-only path, an individual qualifies as an accredited investor with annual income of at least Rs 2 crores. Alternative paths allow qualification through net worth alone, or through Rs 1 crore annual income combined with Rs 5 crores net worth. The Trap: Rs 1 crore annual income alone is not sufficient under the income-only path — it qualifies only when paired with Rs 5 crores net worth under a different path. Note: Individual accreditation has three alternative paths — meeting any one is sufficient.
